All60pictures/PTS exact through2IDRs/frame-numberwrap across7pairs; stale pixel mappings never read in source-hash-bound one-active-reference/no-reorder/no-MMCO profile. Unsafe current-reference release changes output; owner resets exact. First-plane owned-buffer peak125624→15710B, but cheaper certified SPSmax_refs1 baseline uses15703B. Median prepared-runtime cost ratio0.9756,95bootstrap[0.9036,1.0367], no added storage/cost win. Stop this profile; metadata/pixel lifetime mechanism demonstrated, not arbitrary reference liveness qualification. Initial unsafe control still obeyed unique-owner guard and could not remove current aliased reference; it did not validate the negative. Corrected intentionally unsafe control removes current reference view even if alias remains, exposing wrong output; reran correctness before final measurements in fresh runtime. Metric named peakPixels in raw capture is only first AVBuffer owned-byte sum, not all planes/RSS. Header certificate preparation omitted from both prepared runtime jobs; it is common prerequisite, not cold total speed claim.
